items.title: Tyson Bagent: Cleared to practice Saturday
items.description:
Bagent (concussion) will be back at practice Saturday after progressing through the league's concussion protocol, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Caleb Williams: Not practicing Saturday
items.description:

items.title: Zay Flowers: Could be limited if active
items.description:
Flowers (hamstring) is expected to "test his injury" prior to Sunday's game against the Cowboys, and if he suits up he "will likely be on a pitch count," Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
